project.description: Downloads the current query.env for one stack. An uploaded change takes effect only after running PIC-SURE Wildfly Stack Deploy with DEPLOY_QUERY selected; the container bakes its env at create time, so a plain restart picks up nothing. A full Render PIC-SURE Service Config Templates run rotates the shared tokens and then requires redeploying gateway, operations, and query together.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Target stack identifier (for example, a or b).

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# Source every shared Bash script used by Jenkins jobs. source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [[ -f "$script_file" && -x "$script_file" ]]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role reset_role; do if ! command -v "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: required function '$fn' was not loaded from $source_scripts_folder." >&2 exit 1 fi done
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${stack_s3_bucket:?stack_s3_bucket is required}"
trap 'reset_role' EXIT assume_role
# Download the query.env file from S3. It contains live credentials and is never echoed. aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/configs/query/${TARGET_STACK}/query.env" "query.env"
